product.name: Linkana SRM (Supplier Relationship Management) Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform for automating supplier qualification, onboarding, and monitoring integrated with ERP and procurement systems.

product.name: Automated Supplier Qualification and Onboarding
product.description: A process automation feature that streamlines supplier registration, document submission, and approval with configurable workflows.

product.name: Supplier Monitoring and Risk Management
product.description: A tool for continuous monitoring of supplier data, automatic alerts for expiring documents, and risk assessment based on updated information.

product.name: Integration Connectors and ERP Integration
product.description: Native connectors that integrate Linkana SRM with ERP, procurement, and supplier management systems for data synchronization.

product.name: Configurable No-Code Platform Features
product.description: A no-code interface allowing users to customize supplier categories, risk scores, approval workflows, and reporting dashboards.
